To verify the integrity of the stitching boundaries and ensure no fusion artifacts exist between the red thread and white leather, or between the ball and the background.
To analyze the legibility and structural correctness of the printed logos ('Rawlings') and handwritten marks, which are common failure points in AI generation.
To assess global image quality, noise levels, and potential subtle texture anomalies in the leather grain or background fabric.
